blockedModule.title: Module not enabled for this user

kiosk.footerPrivacy: Español disponible · Touch 🎧 Help anytime to talk to a team member · This kiosk's camera is used only to assist your check-in
kiosk.idleBody: For your privacy, this session will reset and clear everything you entered in
kiosk.genericError: Something didn't work — please try again, or touch Help.
kiosk.pairBody: Ask an admin for the 6-digit pairing code (Ride Fleet → Kiosks → Pair new kiosk) and type it below.
kiosk.pairInvalid: That code didn't work — check it with your admin and try again.
kiosk.pairLocked: Too many attempts — ask your admin for a fresh pairing code.
kiosk.welcomeSub: Pick up your reserved car in under 5 minutes — or rent one right now.
kiosk.welcomePickupSub: Pick up your car — enter your confirmation number
kiosk.welcomeWalkupSub: See today's cars and prices, drive out in minutes
kiosk.walkupSoonBody: Walk-up rentals at this kiosk are coming very soon. A team member at the counter will be happy to get you on the road today.
kiosk.lookupSub: Enter your confirmation number, or look yourself up by last name and phone.
kiosk.lookupScanQrSoon: QR scanning is coming soon — please type your confirmation number instead.
kiosk.lookupByName: Can't find it? Look me up by last name + phone
kiosk.lookupNotFound: We couldn't find a matching reservation. Double-check and try again.
kiosk.lookupNotFoundAttempts_one: We couldn't find a matching reservation. {{count}} attempt left before this kiosk locks.
kiosk.lookupNotFoundAttempts_other: We couldn't find a matching reservation. {{count}} attempts left before this kiosk locks.
kiosk.lookupLockedBody: This kiosk paused reservation lookups for a few minutes after several tries. A team member can find your reservation right away.
kiosk.idSub: Hold the back of your license (barcode side) up to the camera.
kiosk.idPrivacy: Your ID photo is processed automatically to read your information. It — and any selfie you take — is used only to verify your identity for this rental and stored securely with your rental record.
kiosk.idCantScan: I can't do this — get help
kiosk.idPhotoSub: Hold the FRONT of your ID up to the camera, then tap "I'm ready" — we'll take the photo for you.
kiosk.idPhotoExtractingSub: This takes a few seconds — don't go anywhere.
kiosk.idPhotoMissingHint: Something missing or wrong? Retake the photo — or touch Help and a team member will assist you.
kiosk.idPhotoUpload: Upload a photo of your ID
kiosk.idPhotoLimitTitle: Let's get you a team member
kiosk.idPhotoLimitBody: We couldn't read your ID after several tries. A team member can verify it in about a minute — you won't start over.
kiosk.idPhotoCameraFailed: The camera isn't available — you can upload a photo of your ID instead, or touch Help.
kiosk.idOcrUnavailable: Automatic ID reading isn't available right now — let's scan the barcode on the back of your license instead.
kiosk.scanSlowHint: Trouble scanning? Try uploading a photo of the barcode instead.
kiosk.scanHoldSteady: Hold the BACK of the license steady — fill the frame with the barcode…
kiosk.scanCameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable — use "Upload barcode photo" instead.
kiosk.scanLiveUnavailable: Live scan unavailable on this device — use "Upload barcode photo" instead.
kiosk.scanPhotoNoBarcode: That photo didn't contain a readable license barcode. Try a sharper, well-lit shot of the BACK of the license.
kiosk.scanPhotoReadFailed: Couldn't read the barcode from that photo. Try a sharper shot of the back of the license, or touch Help.
kiosk.scanHelperNote: Scanning the barcode auto-fills your name, license number, state and expiry.
kiosk.reasonNameMismatch: The name on the license doesn't match the reservation.
kiosk.reasonUnderage: The minimum rental age isn't met.
kiosk.reasonAgeAboveMax: This location rents to drivers up to age {{age}} — a team member can help.
kiosk.invalidPhoto: That photo couldn't be processed — please retake it and try again.
kiosk.reasonDobUnreadable: We couldn't read the date of birth on the license.
kiosk.reasonDobImplausible: The date of birth on the license doesn't look right — a team member can help.
kiosk.reasonExpiryUnreadable: We couldn't read the license expiration date.
kiosk.reasonExpiresBeforeReturn: The license expires before your scheduled return.
kiosk.reasonGeneric: We couldn't verify this detail automatically.
kiosk.selfieTitle: Quick selfie to confirm it's you
kiosk.selfieSub: Center your face in the circle and look at the camera. Take off sunglasses and hats.
kiosk.selfieCameraFailed: The camera isn't available on this device — you can upload a photo instead, or touch Help.
kiosk.selfiePrivacy: Your selfie is used to verify your identity for this rental and is stored securely with your rental record. If we can't verify automatically, a team member will help — you won't start over.
kiosk.verifyStuckTitle: Let's connect you with a person
kiosk.verifyStuckBody: That's okay — it happens. A team member can verify your ID in about a minute. You won't lose your progress.
kiosk.connectAgent: Connect me to a team member
kiosk.noVehicleAvailable: No cars in your class are ready right now — a team member has been notified and will sort it out.
kiosk.offersSub: Prices shown are for your {{days}}-day rental.
kiosk.offersNoneBody: No extras to add for this booking — you're all set to pay and go.
kiosk.offersDepositLine: All options include the {{amount}} refundable deposit at payment — released after return.
kiosk.pkgBasicNoExtras: No added protection or extras — pay-as-you-go for anything that comes up
kiosk.payHoldHint: The hold is not a charge — it's released after you return the car (typically 5–7 business days).
kiosk.payTextLink: Text the payment link to my phone (coming soon)
kiosk.paySandboxDisabled: Sandbox payment isn't enabled in this environment — a team member can complete your payment at the counter.
kiosk.payHowTo: 1. Open your phone camera → 2. Point it at the code → 3. Pay with card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. You never type card numbers on this kiosk.
kiosk.payFailedBody: No charge was made. You can try again, or a team member can help.
kiosk.signReviewHint: Review the key terms below, initial each section, then sign with your finger.
kiosk.signInitialsHint: Draw your initials once, then tap each section to apply them.
kiosk.signMissingInitials: Initial every section above to finish.
kiosk.signPaymentRequired: Payment needs to be completed before signing.
kiosk.signIdVerifyRequired: We need to verify your ID before you can sign — let's scan your license again.
kiosk.doneKeysStaff: Please see a team member at the counter to pick up your keys.
kiosk.doneKeysLockbox: Pick up your keys at the lockbox by the exit.
kiosk.doneContractAskStaff: Ask a team member for a printed copy
kiosk.doneInspectionSent: We emailed you a link to photo-document the car's condition (2 min, protects you)
kiosk.doneInspectionScan: Scan to photo-document the car's condition
kiosk.escalatedTitle: A team member is on the way
kiosk.escalatedBody: We've notified the staff — someone will be right with you to finish your check-in. You won't start over.
kiosk.outOfServiceBody: Please see a team member at the counter — we'll get you on the road.
kiosk.helpBodySession: A team member can take over right where you are — you won't lose your progress.
kiosk.helpBodyNoSession: Please see a team member at the counter — they'll be happy to help.
kiosk.assistSub: Select your name and enter your PIN to help this guest.
kiosk.assistNoPinHint: set your PIN in your profile
kiosk.assistNoPinErr: This staff member has no lock PIN set — set it in your profile first.
kiosk.assistPinInvalidAttempts_one: Invalid PIN — {{count}} attempt left before this kiosk locks.
kiosk.assistPinInvalidAttempts_other: Invalid PIN — {{count}} attempts left before this kiosk locks.
kiosk.assistLockedBody: Too many attempts — the kiosk pauses staff unlock and lookups for 15 minutes. An admin can issue a fresh pairing code to clear it immediately.
kiosk.assistStaffNotFound: Staff member not found — refresh the list and try again.
kiosk.assistGrantExpired: The staff session expired — unlock with your PIN again.
kiosk.assistBothPhotos: Front and back license photos are both required.
kiosk.assistSuccessBody: Verified by {{name}}. Handing back to the guest — the session continues at Protection & extras.
kiosk.assistCorrectHint: Fix a typo in the fields and verify again, or end the assist — the session stays with the team.
kiosk.nameMismatchTitle: The name on your license doesn't match this reservation
kiosk.nameMismatchBody: If the reservation is under a different form of your name — or someone booked it for you — we can fix it in about a minute.
kiosk.nameUpdateTitle: Let's confirm this is your reservation
kiosk.nameUpdateIntro: We'll send a 6-digit code to the email or phone on the reservation. Enter it here and we'll update the driver name to match your license.
kiosk.nameUpdateSentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {{destinations}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
kiosk.nameUpdateInvalidCode: That code isn't right — check it and try again.
kiosk.nameUpdateInvalidCodeAttempts_one: That code isn't right — {{count}} attempt left before this kiosk locks.
kiosk.nameUpdateInvalidCodeAttempts_other: That code isn't right — {{count}} attempts left before this kiosk locks.
kiosk.nameUpdateExpired: That code expired — request a new one.
kiosk.nameUpdateLockedBody: This kiosk paused verification codes for a few minutes after several tries. A team member can sort this out right away.
kiosk.nameUpdateNotEligible: Self-service isn't available for this case — a team member can help.
kiosk.nameUpdateSuccessTitle: Reservation updated to match your ID
kiosk.nameUpdateSuccessBody: You're all set — continuing your check-in.
kiosk.assistNameConfirmBtn: I verified this license matches the guest
kiosk.assistNameHint: You're attesting that you checked the physical license and it belongs to this guest. Age and expiration rules still apply, and this action is audited.

planner.selectTenantBody: Pick a tenant to load its planner board, reservations and vehicles.
planner.dockEmpty: Every reservation in this range has a vehicle.
planner.tipTypeMismatch: Different vehicle class (strict match is on)
planner.tipLockedStatus: Vehicle status is locked (maintenance / out of service)
planner.tipIllegal: This vehicle cannot take the reservation
planner.conflictOccupied: The vehicle is occupied in that range
planner.conflictTurnaround: Too close to another booking (turnaround buffer)
planner.conflictTypeMismatch: The vehicle class does not match the reservation
planner.conflictCrossLocation: The vehicle is homed at a different location
planner.conflictLockedStatus: The vehicle status blocks the assignment
planner.lockedReservation: This reservation is checked out and locked by its agreement.
planner.nothingToClear: No movable reservations are currently assigned in this planner range.
planner.confirmClear: Move {{count}} reservation(s) back to No car for this visible planner range?
planner.clearedCount: {{count}} reservation(s) moved back to No car.
planner.clearedPartial: {{count}} moved to No car; {{skipped}} skipped (locked by their status).
planner.noUnassignedInRange: No unassigned movable reservations were found in this planner range.
planner.suggestionsEmpty: No suitable vehicles were found for this reservation.
planner.overbookedNote: This reservation could not be auto-accommodated and counts as overbooking in this range.
planner.emptyBody: No vehicles match the current filters for this range.
planner.emptySearchBody: No vehicles or reservations match your search.
